comparison.name: Upstream native

comparison.name: WASM Zoo experimental

capabilityMatrix.note: The canary builds the upstream qpdf executable rather than reimplementing PDF operations in JavaScript.
Chromium smoke exercises --check and a real PDF rewrite.
The canary smoke rewrites a generated PDF with --linearize and validates the result.
QPDF's built-in native crypto provider is compiled without OpenSSL/GnuTLS.
Browser execution stages explicit files in Emscripten MEMFS.
The initial QPDF browser canary is single-threaded and does not require cross-origin isolation.

notes: Experimental v0.17 onboarding canary: no GitHub package Release, Playground, npm publication or automatic promotion is enabled yet.
The build consumes the official qpdf-12.4.1.tar.gz release asset and verifies its GitHub-published SHA-256 before extraction.
The reviewed v12.4.1 annotated tag peels to exact upstream commit c37f83ae468abb6cc741f43b2f6fdeb66e550ffb.
The browser build uses QPDF's built-in native crypto provider, Emscripten zlib/libjpeg ports and wasm-native exception handling.
Promotion automation remains disabled until the experimental build and browser smoke are reviewed.
